item.title: Temporal Autocorrelation Structures and Repeated Measures
Temporal Autocorrelation Structures and Repeated Measures
item.description: In this document I provide some details to potentially help clarify the concept of “repeated measures”. I have often found these sorts of experimental design terms to be very confusing. Here I hope to clarify the concept of repeated measures as a method to account for temporal autocorrelation in a dataset. Repeated measures designs are a specific type of design where there is some sort of temporal autocorrelation among data points.

item.title: Vim Useful CheatSheet
item.description: Here I provide some useful commands for using vi. Commenting out a Block of Code Go to first line you want to comment: press ctrl v. This puts you in the Visual Block mode. Use the arrow key and select until the last line. Press Shift i, which puts the editor in Insert mode and then press #. This will add a hash to the first line Press Esc. Copying text to the global clipboard "+y "+p To copy the entire file into the + register, gg"+yG Moving around Move cursor to top of screen: gg Move cursor to bottom: shift + g Move cursot to end of current line: g_ Move to the beginning of line: 0
